description: October 22 birthday meaning: Libra or Scorpio cusp, birthday number 22, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, October 22 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Libra or Scorpio. In numerology the day gives birthday number 22, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: The October 22 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: October 22 is a cusp date, so the Sun sign depends on the birth year and time; most years it falls at around twenty-eight degrees of Libra, a few days before Scorpio begins. Grace meets intensity in this blend. The master number 22, the master builder, suggests large ambitions handled with tact and a capacity to turn private vision into lasting structures.

Astronomically, October 22 puts the Sun near 28° Libra in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. The cusp between Libra and Scorpio, around October 22 to October 24, places charm next to intensity. The Sun leaves a cardinal air sign for a fixed water sign at a moment that drifts from year to year, so which one you are depends on the year, hour and place of your birth. A properly calculated chart gives the answer. Traditionally, people near this line blend Libra's social grace with Scorpio's depth and focus. They are often described as magnetic and perceptive, pleasant on the surface and quietly determined underneath, with more going on than they show.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for October 22
paragraphs: A birthday on the 22nd gives a birthday number of 22, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced. Sometimes called the Master Builder, 22 combines the 2's cooperation with the 4's practicality on a larger scale, suggesting an ability to turn big visions into working structures. Even in the secondary position of a birth day, it is given weight in numerology. People born on this day are often described as idealistic planners, capable of organising many people towards a shared goal. Pressure can come with that potential, so pacing themselves tends to matter a great deal.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an October 22 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous October 22 birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 22 is the 295th day of the year (296th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Scorpio, is usually complete within 2 days, by October 24.

By October 22 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an October 22 birthday are Doris Lessing (1919), Franz Liszt (1811) and Ivan Bunin (1870).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 22?
faq.answer: October 22 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Libra or Scorpio on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Libra. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 22?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 22 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 4 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 22 for everyone born on the 22nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 22?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 22, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 22?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on October 22 include Doris Lessing (1919), Franz Liszt (1811) and Ivan Bunin (1870). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
